text:
joanne: Surprise! We quietly crossed 900M tokens overnight 🎉🥳 Brought donuts + banana bread to the kitchen. Tiny gong by the plant for a 2pm five-minute toast — who’s in?

alex: NO WAY. banana bread?? i'm sprinting. :banana:

maria: @joanne you absolute legend. can we also have a caffeine donation jar? :coffee:

ben: I can bring a mini gong (yes it exists). Someone grab napkins pls.

sam: :confetti_ball: quick drinks poll — champagne, kombucha, or iced coffee?

deploy-bot: metric update: tokens_processed = 900123456 (congrats team!!)

joanne: Planning a 2pm toast + quick team photo for #social. Remote folks — i'll drop pics and a short clip.

alex: remote here but can cheer via GIFs. photos = full applause.

maria: vote time — banana bread (🍌) vs cupcakes (🧁). reply with emoji to vote.

ben: 🍌

sam: 🧁

alex: 🍌

joanne: Tally so far banana bread 2 - cupcakes 1. maybe i'll bring both just in case.

maria: potluck energy. i'll bake another loaf if banana bread wins. 😄

alex: 2pm gong practice — who wants to ring first?

ben: i'll volunteer to be ceremonial gonger. link for remote folks: https://zoom.company/2pm-toast

sam: i'll hang the '1B TOKENS NEXT!' banner (ok it's just a strip of paper but still 🪧).

joanne: tagging the kitchen volunteers mentally. See you all at 2 — bring tiny utensils and big cheer :tada:

alex: See you! :tada:
